items.label: Content pipeline
items.title: Cut a 6-hour weekly content task to
items.description: One event now triggers the whole chain: update emails and feedback requests go out, posts for LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Facebook get drafted from what happened, and a stats page tracks how everything performed. The only human step left is approving the drafts.

items.label: Voice writer
items.title: LinkedIn posts in their own voice —
items.description: It learns how a specific person writes, then produces personal updates, industry commentary and company announcements that sound like them, not a template. They edit instead of starting from a blank page.
